summary: Replication repairs are applied 16 to a writer hold, in the same id order as before, instead of all in one hold; a call that stops between pages finishes on the next call, and a call with no repairs takes no writer hold

replay.detail: No claim or projection replay. Every call still applies every recorded repair in id order; a repair already applied changes nothing.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or CLI change. apply_replication_repairs returns the repairs it changed, summed over its pages. Between two pages of one call, readers can see the earlier pages' repairs before the later ones.
